blocks.prompt: 4 How many signals can be given by 6 flags of different colours, using 2 flags at a time?
blocks.explanation:
Pehle samajhiye signal kaise banta hai: do jhande (flags) ek ke upar ek lagaye jate hain. Laal upar aur neela neeche, aur neela upar laal neeche, yeh do alag signal hain, yani tarteeb (order) ahem hai.
Humein signals ki ginti karni hai.
Plan: 6 jhandon mein se 2 chun kar tarteeb se lagane hain, to yeh \({}^{6}P_{2}\) hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 6 alag rangon ke flags, ek waqt mein 2 istemal hote hain.
Humein find karna hai: kitne signals ban sakte hain.
Tareeqa: Jab order se jawab badal jaye to permutation lagta hai. Is liye \({}^{n}P_{r}\) jahan \(n = 6\) (kul flags) aur \(r = 2\) (ek waqt mein flags).

Formula lagayein
\[{}^{6}P_{2} = \dfrac{6!}{(6-2)!} = \dfrac{6!}{4!}\]
\[= \dfrac{6 \cdot 5 \cdot 4!}{4!} = 6 \cdot 5\]
Kyun: \(6!\) ko \(6 \cdot 5 \cdot 4!\) likha taake \(4!\) cancel ho jaye; poora \(6! = 720\) nikaalne ki zaroorat nahi.

Multiply karein
\[6 \times 5 = 30\]
Kyun: \(r = 2\) hai, is liye do hi factors bache.

Tasdeeq
Box method: upar wali jagah ke liye 6 choices, neeche wali ke liye 5 (kyunke ek flag upar lag chuka). \(6 \times 5 = 30\) \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Ek hi flag do dafa nahi lag sakta.
Dhyan dein: Agar yahan order ahem na hota (sirf jhando ka jora) to jawab \({}^{6}C_{2} = 15\) hota; signal mein order ahem hai, is liye 30.
